title: UUID order equals the canonical text order
verdict: a `UUID` orders as its lower-case hyphenated text does
description: `ORDER BY`, `min` and `max` of a `UUID` column agree with the same over `CAST(id AS VARCHAR)`, including values whose first bit is set (`80000000-…`, `ffffffff-…`).
reference: sverify refuses the column by its declared type (`sverify_duckdb.declared`, #1253): Arrow exports it as another kind, and the lift would compare it as that kind. The exit is a cast to text in the source query.

evidence.sql: SELECT id::VARCHAR FROM u ORDER BY id  -- u holds ffffffff-0000-…, 00000000-…-000000000001, 7fffffff-…, 80000000-…, 0a000000-…
SELECT id::VARCHAR FROM u ORDER BY id::VARCHAR
evidence.observed: the same five rows in the same order

evidence.sql: SELECT min(id)::VARCHAR, max(id)::VARCHAR, min(id::VARCHAR), max(id::VARCHAR) FROM u
